# Event Master Plan — 2026-W23

**Event window:** June 4–10, 2026

---

## Event Summary

This week adds seven Community Mission Series jobs and shifts the cash focus to Meth / Street Dealer income. The strongest guaranteed objective is the Stash House weekly challenge, while the biggest active bonus is platform-gated Community Mission Series 4x GTA$ and RP.

---

## New Community Mission Series

Complete all seven to receive GTA$500,000 within 72 hours:

1. Los Santos 2062 by ShelbyGR-1
2. Juggernightmare by GTA Series Videos
3. Paleto Bay Slasher by Shadow-Break
4. The Scrumble Heist by SergeantDexter
5. Running the Gauntlet by Sarah-Croft
6. Detective Story by BooCooSocial
7. Old School Hits by GTA Series Videos

Platform note: source lists this for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC Enhanced.
